versions.content: In cas e of a reception related to a SoAdSocketRouteDest, that refers to a global PDU structure configured with a MetaDataItem of the type SOCKET_CONNECTION_ID_16, which is contained in a SoAdSocketRoute that refers to a socket connection group, SoAd shall use Pd uInfoType.MetaDataPtr to provide the socket connection identifier (SoConId) where the PDU was received with <Up>_[SoAd][If]RxIndication() .
